taskDescription: Click every amino acid in the list below that is essential in adults (its carbon skeleton cannot be synthesised by the body).
textField: Human proteins are built from twenty amino acids. The set includes *valine*, alanine, *leucine*, glutamate, *isoleucine*, serine, *phenylalanine*, glycine, *tryptophan*, aspartate, *methionine*, cysteine, *threonine*, tyrosine, *lysine*, proline, *histidine*, asparagine, glutamine and arginine.

overallFeedback.feedback: The nine essential amino acids (valine, leucine, isoleucine, phenylalanine, tryptophan, methionine, threonine, lysine, histidine) cannot have their carbon skeletons made by human enzymes and must come from the diet; arginine is semi-essential — adult requirements are usually met, but the diet must supply extra arginine during growth, when demand is higher.
